archetypes.name: dyn-sidecar-paths
archetypes.rationale: Changed fallback path resolution for ledger-provided failure detail sidecars.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the stall recovery sidecar fallback path handling. Verify ledger values remain tmpdir-relative only, symlinks and oversize files are rejected, and prefixed artifacts cannot read default-scope sidecars. Check that fallback reads do not widen the accepted external path surface. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-stall-reporting
archetypes.rationale: Classification and Tier A report composition now share sidecar evidence fallback behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review classify and compose-report behavior around oversize failure-detail logs. Confirm primary valid logs still win, invalid primaries can fall back to the newest valid escalation sidecar, and no-detail classify calls do not invent evidence. Pay special attention to generic artifact-prefix behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
